sections.text:
[Effects]
Reflects physical and magic damage taken by XXL.
Target: yourself. Applies an invulnerability effect that nullifies physical or magic damage 1 time.
Reduces physical Ability Power by 3XL.
Reduces magic Ability Power by 3XL.

[Activation]
When physical or magic damage is taken.

[Activation Rate]
L
Activation rate scales with the number of Neutral elemental Clothing type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).
